facility.name: Chipos Little House
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child enrolled into care full time at the child care home did not have a food allergy emergency plan on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §747.3619)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Animals: The written operational policies for the child care home did not list any information regarding the pet that is present in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Animals (26 TAC §747.501(7))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: The pet in the home had a current vaccination record but did not have a statement of health from a local veterinarian on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: During the time of inspection, three of the children did not have their most current/required immunizations on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: During the inspection time there was no record available to indicate that any lockdown or severe weather drills had been conducted while children were in care. Only notated drills were for the fire drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): During the inspection, the operation was missing the Form 2912 affidavits for its two employees.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §747.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: During the inspection, a child in care did not have a completed emergency medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: During the inspection, a caregiver did not have evidence of their educational background on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §747.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: During the inspection, two child records did not have names for their emergency contacts on their forms. The operator contacted the parents and obtained these names.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: During  the inspection an infant was in a bouncy chair device for 30 minutes. The maximum allowed is 15 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §747.2317(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: During the walkthrough, no cleaning supplies or sharp objects were found accessible to children. Locks had been added to several of the floor level cabinets in the kitchen.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Comply with Child-care Licensing Law and Rules: The operator has had several recent and repeated deficiencies of minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Comply with Child-care Licensing Law and Rules (26 TAC §747.207(9))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: During the walkthrough, the kitchen cabinets accessible to children had cleaning supplies in them. No lock or gate prevented access to these cabinets. The operator did zip tie the cabinet closed after the issue was pointed out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home: During a walkthrough of the home, it was discovered that operation had 7 children in the age range of 2 to 3 years old and two children under 17 months old in care of a single caregiver. With a single caregiver caring for twos  infants, the maximum number of children under 4 but older than 17 months in care can be 5.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home: During a walkthrough of the home, it was discovered that operation had 8 children in the age range of 2 to 3 years old and a single child under 17 months old in care of a single caregiver. With a single caregiver caring for a single infant, the maximum number of children under 3 but older than 17 months in care can be 6.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: During the walkthrough, the kitchen cabinets accessible to children had cleaning supplies and sharp objects in them. No lock or gate prevented access to these cabinets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups: During the walkthrough, toddler aged children were observed multiple times walking while drinking from their cups or bottles
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §747.2405(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Planned Activities - Designed to meet individual needs and developmental levels of children in the group: During the inspection, no written activity plans were available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned Activities - Designed to meet individual needs and developmental levels of children in the group (26 TAC §747.2101)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Sliding Door Glass Marked: This standard was found deficient after the home's sliding door was found to lack decals or other materials placed at children's eye level.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Sliding Door Glass Marked (26 TAC §747.3501(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: This standard was found deficient because some outlets in the home lacked safety covers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A child under the age of 18 months was napping in a restrictive device. The child was removed from the device when I informed the caregiver that the child cannot sleep in it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §747.2326(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Four children did not have the address of their emergency contact listed on the enrollment packet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child did not have a healthcare provider statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child did not have immunization records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: At the time of inspection the air unit in the backyard of the home was exposed with no barrier and accessible to children if they were in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §747.3501(3))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: At the time of inspection, the provider did not have any operational policies written for the child care home to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))
